lines.en: I flap my ears and fly, staying low.
My two big ears work like wings.
I float at half a person's height.

lines.zh: 我飞一段就落下来歇歇
lines.en: I fly a stretch, then land to rest.
The wind pushes me off course.
I skim over the tops of the grass.
The plains grass bends in the wind.
I circle in midair.
My ears beat slowly, but enough.
I bob along, up and down.
I perch on a low tree.
I am a little tired of flying.
I sit on the grass.
My ears droop at my sides.
Front paws clean, now my face

lines.zh: 背上的毛被晒得暖暖的
lines.en: The sun has warmed the fur on my back
I am small; the grass is taller.

The dirt falls off my ears
This plain is wide open.
I look up at the clouds.
I have nothing much to do.

I curl up on myself.
I fold my ears back.

lines.zh: 一片两片，数到一半忘了
lines.en: One blade, two, I forget halfway

I am light; I will not weigh you down.

lines.zh: 我落在你面前的石头上
lines.en: I land on the stone before you.
So we just look at each other.

Please do not frighten me.

One ear high, one ear low

lines.zh: 这一下让我晕了一会儿
lines.en: That left me dizzy a while.
I fly out from beside your leg.
We nearly collided.
I am still only a little one.
That is a long way from me.

My ears are not fully grown.

I do not know what to say.
I am a little shy.

Holding it, I cannot fly high.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的耳朵就缩了
lines.en: Fire nears and my ears flatten.

lines.zh: 我被吹得翻了好几个圈
lines.en: The blast sends me tumbling over and over

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身都麻了
lines.en: Lightning falls and my whole body numbs.
No grass here, and no wind.
